decision_basis: The corrected DELL Evidence Pack was materially used by the 13-node chain: demand durability, profit transmission, supply constraints, competition and counterevidence improved rather than merely gaining citations.

The selected-Evidence numeric co-compilation control plane has a prior two-worker clean proof and closes the project-side inventory and source-rounded presentation gaps that blocked the changed-input report.

The one-call natural canary selected the correct issuer Evidence, four bound NUM refs, competitor read-through and pull-forward boundaries. Its only formal failure was exact English inflection, not a financial fact or research-judgment error.

The provider-neutral local renderer now proves strict relation, entity, period, unit, value and lineage while changing only the protected grammatical surface; two clean archives reproduce identical receipts without a second model call.
The remaining weak WWC, mechanism bridges, decision density and full-report research quality are S3 obligations and must not keep expanding S2 numeric-control work.

allowed: select approved Evidence and NUM refs
produce thesis, support, counterevidence and epistemic-boundary atoms
propose mechanisms, research follow-ups and observable What-Would-Change conditions
write non-authoritative analytical prose within S3 node contracts
local_control_plane_retained: case, entity, period, currency and unit identity
Evidence lineage, deterministic IDs and final numeric guard
forbidden: unbound material numbers or free arithmetic
turning supplier, competitor or market context into issuer-specific facts
valuation multiples, target price or recommendation from a single market close
silent gap closure or invented external Evidence
full-report promotion without S3 L1/L2 and research-content quality acceptance
automatic retry or another S2 natural canary

required_outputs: dynamic DecisionSurface and EvidenceRequest loop over governed local plus official Evidence
mechanism, counterevidence and observable WWC contracts
same-input comparison against the Codex reference and hidden eight-dimension quality rubric
fresh exact-once authority decision before any model or tool live

known_boundary: S2 is closed only for its bounded model-consumption and numeric-control responsibilities. This is not a post-repair full DELL report pass, a three-case Agentic Research proof, qualified-human acceptance, Workbench dogfood or release. S1 residual source and valuation gaps remain typed inputs to S3 rather than silently closed.
